annotations.title: Is an address a contract or a wallet? Code size, EIP-1967 proxy implementation/a

description: Is an address a contract or a wallet? Code size, EIP-1967 proxy implementation/admin/beacon, EIP-7702 delegation. Reads the bytecode of an address on a chain: EOA vs contract, code size and hash, EIP-7702 delegated EOAs, minimal-proxy (EIP-1167) targets, EIP-1967 implementation/admin/beacon slots and legacy ZeppelinOS proxies (e.g. USDC). Also returns the native balance and nonce. Price: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).

chain.description: One of ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc, avalanche, gnosis, base-sepolia, sepolia (or a chain id)
